Night seat (relay session #8):
- TASK-1736 is up as #2588: `aida role expiry` (warn within 2h; exit 3 under --refuse-within), a statusline "(expires in Xm)" suffix, and a SessionStart hook warning. Local gates pass: 5 e2e + 6 unit tests, and check-ci-fast (27 gates). CI is pending.
- Relay side: joemooney/aida-relay#87 halts with BLOCKED_ON_HUMAN (exit 3) before launching a session when under 1h remains (configurable via AIDA_RELAY_GRANT_REFUSE_WITHIN). An older aida without the subcommand exits 2, which is not treated as a refusal.
- #2587 (BUG-1983) is rebased and green, but held until #2588 merges, per your ruling. A note is on the PR.
- #2586 is green and marked NIGHT READY.
- TASK-1737 is not started; it is waiting on your approval.
